scope: BoardGamesManager, DartsGameManager, PoolGameManager native client TCP payload contracts
provenance: Static IL2CPP metadata plus focused Ghidra12.1.3 pseudocode; no target execution or network observations. Hashes identify source artifacts, not original C# or REA evidence IDs.
status: Client field-consumption and emission contracts recovered; original server state parity is unproved.
index_convention: Zero-based fields after opcode removal; C2S indices before generic #platform-name trailer.
transport_dependency: See tcp-reconstruction.md and tcp-contracts.json. Mirror NebulaMessage wraps AES128ECB/PKCS7 Base64 payload; C2S AES adds #StandaloneWindows or #PS4. S2C handlers do not generically strip that tail.
entrydata_dependency: tools/avatar_entry_codec.py is the canonical shared codec reconstruction. Use its ordered-schema decode_entry_fields/encode_entry_fields API with entrydata_dtos.*.canonical_codec_schema. Floats encode from explicit lexical strings; decode null marker does not itself model initialized CLR field/reused-array skip assignment. This protocol is not JSON.

entrydata_grammar.scalar: Enum Object.ToString names then Enum.Parse; bool True/False; numeric strings, float InvariantCulture.
entrydata_grammar.array: A prefixed decimal count token, followed by elements. Primitive/string elements are tokens; EntryData subclass elements recursively concatenate their fields without outer element wrapper.
entrydata_grammar.null_array: Prefixed nulls token causes deserializer to leave the existing field unchanged; it is not equivalent to a fresh empty array.
entrydata_grammar.nested_class: EntryData fields concatenate recursively without an outer token. Deserialization relies on initialized nested objects; null nested object serialization omits fields and is not a safe stand-alone grammar.
entrydata_grammar.scope_note: Codec facts supplied by independent avatar_contracts static audit; see its source-hashed canonical deliverable for complete evidence.

envelope.format: One rules character 0..3 followed by concrete board text; rules0 does not deserialize a body.

TicTacToe.format: One character per tiles[] entry in array order. Lowercase x selects player0/X object; lowercase o selects player1/O object; other characters leave tile state untouched.
TicTacToe.effects: Recognized x/o activates its mark and clears tile-selectability flag. No implicit clearing for unrecognized character in this method.
TicTacToe.validation: Text must have at least tiles.Length UTF16 characters; extra characters are ignored.

Chess.format: One character per board tile in outer dimension0, inner dimension1 order. 0 is empty; p/r/n/b/q/k = Pawn/Rook/Knight/Bishop/Queen/King. Lowercase selects White(0), uppercase selects Black(1). This case convention differs from FEN.
Chess.effects: Destroy/clear both existing piece lists, recreate pieces at grid coordinates.
Chess.validation: Only mapped lower/uppercase letters and0 are supported; other characters cause dictionary lookup failure; short text causes get_Chars bounds failure; extra text ignored.
Chess.unknown: Grid dimensions depend on initialized board asset Bounds.Rows/Colums; constructor field defaults alone do not prove serialized asset dimensions.

Draughts.format: One character per board tile in outer dimension0, inner dimension1 order. 0 is empty; r/R=Regular, k/K=King. Lowercase selects White(1), uppercase selects Red(0).
Draughts.effects: Destroy/clear both existing piece lists, recreate pieces at grid coordinates.
Draughts.validation: Only r/R/k/K and0 supported; invalid nonzero char dictionary lookup fails; short text get_Chars fails; extra text ignored.
Draughts.unknown: Grid dimensions are initialized from serialized Bounds.Rows/Colums; no authoritative server dimensions inferred.

TicTacToe.effects: Set isPlayersTurn=true; index tiles[targetX*3+targetY]; store playerIndex and activate X for0 or O for1; clear tile-selectability, show local pointer/control UI.
TicTacToe.validation: Origin coordinates unused. Array bounds checked for flattened index; no occupancy/turn/legal-move check in this ApplyMove body. Player values other than0/1 still get stored but activate neither mark.

Chess.effects: Copy originX/Y to initialized input.moveData, call SelectDestination(targetX,targetY), set isPlayersTurn=true, activate side1-playerIndex, update selected tile/pointer/control UI.
Chess.unknown: SelectDestination and concrete BoardGameLogic legal-move/animation behavior are transitive gameplay algorithms beyond this network wrapper; original server adjudication remains unknown.

Draughts.effects: SelectOrigin(originX,Y), SelectDestination(targetX,Y). If multipleMove=false: isPlayersTurn=true, activate side1-playerIndex, clear activatedMoves and update pointer/control UI. If multipleMove=true, carry target coordinates into originX/Y for the next jump.
Draughts.unknown: Multiple-capture legality, promotion and termination depend on deeper local gameplay methods; no original server decision policy is established.

Pool rules variants, authoritative foul/win adjudication, ball-contact/physics trust, sequence/ack timing, replay recipient selection and result/XP accounting.
Initialized asset grid dimensions and authoritative legal coordinate bounds are not recovered from snapshot parsers; concrete input replay calls into deeper local gameplay methods.

Request35/85 send caller-provided strings; their EntryData move types are established on the receiving side. Full outbound gameplay construction and all concrete local rule algorithms are separate from the sender's field contract.
